function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

message.content:
Hey there! 👋 I’m your friendly AI assistant—think of me as a Swiss‑army knife for knowledge, creativity, and everyday problem solving. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do: | Category | What I’ll Help With | |----------|---------------------| | **Information & Learning** | • Answer trivia or explain concepts (science, history, tech, art)
• Summarize articles, books, research papers
• Translate between languages | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, reports, essays, blog posts, poems, stories
• Proofread grammar, style, tone
• Generate outlines or brainstorm ideas | | **Coding & Tech Support** | • Write snippets in multiple programming languages
• Debug code logic (no runtime execution though)
• Explain algorithms, data structures, best practices | | **Planning & Organization** | • Create schedules, itineraries, meal plans
• Set reminders (conceptually; I don’t have persistent storage)
• Offer productivity tips | | **Creative Projects** | • Design characters, worlds, plot twists
• Compose music lyrics, chord progressions
• Suggest visual arts prompts | | **Practical Advice** | • Give guidance on health habits, fitness routines, budgeting basics
• Provide cooking recipes based on ingredients you list | | **Fun & Entertainment** | • Play text-based games, quizzes, riddles
• Tell jokes, share interesting facts | And much more! Just let me know what you’re looking for, and I’ll tailor my response accordingly. 🚀
message.reasoning: User asks general question about capabilities. We should respond politely and mention we can help with many tasks like answering questions, providing explanations, generating content, etc. No need to call tool.
